newsitem.title: UK: Orange rises on subscriber growth.
newsitem.headline: Orange rises on subscriber growth.

text.p: Shares in Orange Plc rose 5p to 219p by 0859 GMT on Tuesday after the group said its subscriber base topped 850,000 by the end of February, dealers said.
The UK mobile phone operator, which reported its first annual results since flotation last March, said its market share had risen to 11.5 percent from seven percent.
The company, whose major stock holder is Hutchison Whampoa Ltd, said its pre-tax losses had widened to 229 million pounds.
"The figures were about in line. The encouraging news was the number of subcribers the company now has," said one market maker.
